# myUNO

> myUNO — цифровая инфраструктура для жизни, аренды и инвестиций иностранца на Пхукете. Один аккаунт объединяет 40+ микро-приложений: недвижимость, услуги, юридическая помощь, образ жизни.

myUNO is a Russian-speaking super-app for foreigners in Phuket, Thailand. The platform serves three core segments: investors ($2M+), relocators ($300–800K) and second-home buyers ($200–500K). It combines property discovery (resale, off-plan with the proprietary ClearView™ rating, long-term rentals), property management for owners, legal/visa/tax advisory, lifestyle services (cleaning, transfers, beauty, fitness, pets, kids, weddings), and an investor capital desk.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Super-app entry point with personalized recommendations.
- [Property](/property): Buy, rent, or browse new builds in Phuket.
- [New Builds](/newbuilds): Off-plan developments rated by ClearView™ (AAA–CCC).
- [Invest](/invest): Real estate and business investment opportunities for capital clients.
- [Capital](/capital): Concierge advisory for investors $2M+.
- [Legal](/legal): Visas, taxes, company formation, contracts.
- [Relocate](/relocate): Step-by-step relocation guide for families and digital nomads.
- [Services](/services): Marketplace of vetted local providers.
- [Beauty](/beauty), [Fitness](/fitness), [Pets](/pets), [Kids](/kids), [Wedding](/wedding): Lifestyle verticals.
- [Map](/map): Universal map of properties, services and venues.
- [ClearView](/property/clearview): Methodology for rating off-plan developers.
- [List With Us](/list-with-us): Onboarding for owners, vendors and developers.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription tiers for property managers and vendors.
